title: Discount On Your First Game With The Cyberpunk RED Humble Bundle!
summary: Humble Bundle is partnering with StartPlaying to offer big savings on everything you need to play Cyberpunk RED.
body_markdown:
Listen up, chooms! Word on the street is that a new deal is coming to town and it’s got your name all over it. **Humble Bundle** is partnering with **StartPlaying** to offer big savings on everything you need to play ***Cyberpunk RED*** with Roll20, Demiplane, or PDF. Including a discount code for your first session with a Professional Game Master.


The[Cyberpunk Red Ready-to-Run Essentials Bundle](https://humblebundleinc.sjv.io/oN0gvY) **** goes live on **June 2** . If you chrome up with the highest tier, you’ll get:


- Cyberpunk RED Cross-Platform Bundle
- Danger Gal Dossier Cross-Platform Bundle
- Cyberpunk RED: Edgerunners Mission Kit Cross-Platform Bundle
- Black Chrome Cross-Platform Bundle
- Tales of the RED: Street Stories Cross-Platform Bundle
- Official Loke Battle Mats, Soundtracks, And More!


Of course all the gear in the world won’t get you anywhere without a good Fixer to set you up with gigs. So to help you go from newbie to Night City legend, Humble Bundle is also providing a discount code. Use this code when you make a new StartPlaying account to get money off your first game with a **pro Cyberpunk GM** .


Don’t know the right person for the job? Browse[available Cyberpunk RED games here](https://startplaying.games/play/cyberpunk-red) to see all the GMs running and at what times. You can also find out about their playstyles so you know if you’ll make a good crew.


It’s never been a better time to start making a name for yourself in Night City. With the **Cyberpunk Humble Bundle** , and the right GM, you’re bound to do big things.
